about: Synthetic support documents written for this build on October 20, 2026. No third-party text.

versions.1: You can ask for a refund within 14 days of delivery. The refund goes back to the original payment method.
versions.2: You can ask for a refund within 30 days of delivery. The refund goes back to the original payment method.

versions.1: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 working days. Express delivery takes 1 working day and costs extra.
You can change the delivery address on your order page until the order ships. After it ships, contact the carrier.
Electronics come with a one-year warranty from the delivery date. The warranty covers manufacturing defects, not accidental damage.
If your password was changed without your permission, reset it from the sign-in page and contact support at once.
The tracking link in your confirmation email shows where your order is and when it should arrive.
To return an item, print the return label from your order page and take the parcel to any post office within the refund period.
